acceptance: A PR that removes a suppression but keeps its evidence fails comment-policy on that PR
A PR that only removes stale evidence passes comment-policy on a broken base
No weakening: entries whose token still exists at head are still required
context: Found 2026-10-13/14: develop broke after #2948 and was repaired by #2954 with an owner merge. Mechanism verified on develop 9400b62c4. Owner: comment-policy tooling.
description:
## Problem
- `scripts/check_comment_cleanup_scope.py` (`check_token_evidence` `:300-307`, `:1130,1136`) checks scope evidence only against blobs at the base commit. `scripts/check_comment_policy.py:210-211` also loads that policy from the base.
- A PR that removes a suppression but keeps its evidence entry passes its own check. Once merged, it breaks every later PR, and a repair PR fails too, because the policy is read from the base.
- This happened: #2948 (`d73788211`) broke `comment-policy`/`tooling` for every PR. The repair #2954 (`c14ecdb9c`) had to skip the hook and be owner-merged with comment-policy failing.
- It was reproduced in a three-commit temp clone: the stale removal passes (rc 0), a later unrelated PR fails (rc 2), and the repair fails.

## Change
- Also validate the head policy against the head blobs, so a stale entry fails the PR that creates it.
- Accept a head policy that only removes entries whose token count at the head is 0, so a repair can land through the normal flow.
- Add a three-commit regression test.
